description: This file defines abstract base classes for the TestLink project in PHP, including classes for object management, serialization, database interaction, and attachments. It provides core infrastructure for objects within the TestLink system, such as caching, serialization interfaces, and database table/view mappings.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Abstract class defining constants for success, error, and not implemented status codes in the TestLink system.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Base class for all managed TestLink objects, providing common properties, constructor, and methods for user feedback, serialization, and object identification.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Extends tlObject to include a database connection, serving as a base for objects that interact with a database.

classes.name: tlObjectWithAttachments
classes.description: Extends tlObjectWithDB to support attachment handling; manages attachment repositories and related operations.

classes.name: tlDBObject
classes.description: Extends tlObject to include database serialization, object caching, and factory methods for object creation and deletion.

methods.name: setAuditLogOn
methods.description: Enables audit logging for the object.

methods.name: setAuditLogOff
methods.description: Disables audit logging for the object.

methods.name: setAuditEventSource
methods.description: Sets the source of audit events, e.g., GUI or API.

methods.name: getUserFeedback
methods.description: Returns user feedback message associated with the object.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationFormatDescriptions
methods.description: Returns descriptions of supported serialization formats.

methods.name: handleNotImplementedMethod
methods.description: Returns an error code for methods that are not implemented.

methods.name: getDBTables
methods.description: Returns a map of database table names, optionally filtered by a list of table names.

methods.name: getDBViews
methods.description: Returns a map of database view names, optionally filtered by a list of view names.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Class constructor initializing properties like object ID and serialization interfaces.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Object destructor calling the internal clean-up method.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
